reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Increase the amount of PEM data `pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes` is able to parse, to enable reading larger TLS trust bundles", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A parsing limit was increased so larger trust bundles can be read; no operational failure is described.

proposed.statement: pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes can now parse a larger amount of PEM data, allowing larger TLS trust bundles to be read.
